edges.fact: Daikanyama is a neighborhood in Tokyo where the user found a great coffee shop.
Minato Mirai 21 is a futuristic district in Yokohama with a stunning harbor view.
Landmark Tower, which offers panoramic views of the city from its observation deck, is located within Minato Mirai 21.
Yokohama Chinatown, one of the largest Chinatowns in the world with over 500 shops and restaurants, is located in Yokohama.
Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse is a historic warehouse complex converted into a shopping and dining destination in Yokohama.
Yamashita Park is a scenic waterfront park in Yokohama with views of the harbor.
Sankeien Garden is a Japanese garden in Yokohama that is especially beautiful during autumn with maple trees turning red and orange.
Cup Noodles Museum, dedicated to the history of instant ramen, is located in Yokohama.
Yokohama Museum of Art is a modern art museum in Yokohama featuring Japanese and international art.
Meiji Shrine is a serene shrine located in the midst of bustling Harajuku.
Kawai Shrine is a smaller, lesser-known shrine located in a quiet alleyway in Harajuku.
Cat Street is a trendy, lesser-known shopping street in Harajuku.
Takenoko Dori is a trendy, lesser-known shopping street in Harajuku.
Kawai Shrine's Lucky Bell is a unique feature of Kawai Shrine that, according to legend, grants a wish when rung.
Kanemasa has served high-quality kanimeshi (crab rice bowl) for over 30 years, with crab that is always fresh and flavorful.
Kanemasa is a well-known restaurant located in Yokohama Chinatown.
Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi is a sushi restaurant known for its fresh, seasonal namashirasu (raw sardine sushi), which often sells out quickly.
Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi is a sushi restaurant located near the Yokohama Fish Market.
Yokohama Fish Market has food stalls offering a variety of fresh seafood, including kanimeshi and namashirasu, at reasonable prices in Yokohama.
Yokohama Central Market is a bustling marketplace located near the Yokohama Fish Market.
Yokohama Central Market has many food stalls and restaurants serving fresh seafood such as sushi, sashimi, and grilled fish, and sells souvenirs and local goods, in Yokohama.
Yokohama Oktoberfest is a German-style beer festival with food, drinks, and live music, taking place in Yokohama from mid-October to early November.
Yokohama Autumn Leaves Festival (Yokohama Koyo Matsuri) features autumn foliage, food stalls, and traditional Japanese performances, usually taking place in Yokohama in late November.
Maple Leaf Tunnel is a 100-meter-long tunnel lined with maple trees illuminated in red, orange, and yellow, part of the autumn illuminations at Minato Mirai 21.
Harvest Moon Garden is a beautifully lit garden featuring a large, glowing moon and autumn flowers, part of the autumn illuminations at Minato Mirai 21.
Cosmo World is an amusement park located within Minato Mirai 21, featuring a light show and projection mapping on the Ferris wheel during autumn illuminations.
